title: wktest staging build + storm-safe deploy pipeline
desc: T1 core. Build, smoke, and deploy wkappbot through wktest-* staging so Windows Defender (which quarantines the canonical unsigned exe by name) and spawn storms cannot brick it. Covers wkbuild single-file publish, the smoke gate, copy-promote, and the storm reflexes. Cluster: defender-dev-exclusions, wkdoctor-system-physician, wkdr-emergency-doctor-wkappbot-core-spawn-storm-kill, crash-reboot-recovery-cascade, wkappbot-build-verify-workflow.
steps: WHY: canonical wkappbot.exe and wkappbot-core.exe are unsigned single-file exes; Windows Defender realtime QUARANTINES them by name within ~0ms of any write (copy AND rename both deleted), while a wktest-prefixed copy of the SAME bytes survives. So build and validate under a wktest-* name and deploy the canonical name only after a Defender exclusion exists (see defender-dev-exclusions).

BUILD: wkbuild.cmd calls wktest-build.sh which runs dotnet publish with -p:SkipDeployCore=true (single-file self-contained, NO loose dll; SkipDeployCore disables the csproj DeployToSdkBin AfterTargets=Publish target that would auto-copy the canonical exe AND run eye tick). Stage name is wktest-core-(model)-v(version).exe: model from env WKHARNESS_AGENT_MODEL (else manual), version computed from git (base plus rev-list count) NOT by running the 247MB exe.

SMOKE GATE: wktest-smoke.sh runs version, skill list (junk-excluded count), skill read on-load (FULL body no developer-only truncation), skill search, single-file integrity (no loose core dll), and a spawn-storm check (delta of wkappbot-core processes at most 10, NOT any-spawn, because a live deploy legitimately spawns a core or two). It doubles as GC (retention keep N per model plus age-gated sweep). Promotion is refused unless smoke exits 0.

AUTO-DEPLOY after smoke PASS: COPY the staging exe to wkappbot-core.exe ONLY. Do NOT create wkappbot-core.new.exe: that .new file is the FSW hot-swap marker a residual Eye or guardian watches and respawns from, which with Defender deleting results cascaded into a 2261-process spawn storm. Build and deploy the launcher (self-contained trimmed, no dll) co-located with the core.

REFLEX A Defender: if the canonical name keeps vanishing, Defender is quarantining it; run wkdoctor -DefenderFix (admin, one UAC) or add the bin to Defender exclusions, then redeploy (see defender-dev-exclusions and wkdoctor-system-physician).

REFLEX B harness fork-bomb: the brief-guard once validated each skill ref by SPAWNING wkappbot skill read per ref on every tool call; under a missing or broken binary these pile up into a carpet-bomb of skill-read core processes. Fix: validate refs by FILE EXISTENCE of the id.skill.json under the HQ catalog, never by spawning (see wkdr-emergency-doctor-wkappbot-core-spawn-storm-kill and crash-reboot-recovery-cascade).

REFLEX C skill discipline: a skill command CHAINED with another command means intent NOT to read the skill; the harness exempts only a SINGLE non-chained wkappbot skill or speak, wkhippo, wktest, or wkbuild command (Test-WkSingleCmdExempt). Read skills standalone. An Opus that does not read skills performs at Haiku level.

EMERGENCY: a live spawn storm is killed by the harness-immune doctor (wkdr nuke, absolute-path taskkill) kill-only, never deleting the binaries. Do NOT re-promote until the spawn source is identified or it re-accumulates.
author: claude
